name: Improved Suppressing Fire (Combat)
body:
Your automatic firearm attacks leave your enemies vulnerable.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Reflexes, Suppressing Fire, base attack bonus +8

Benefit(s): When you use Suppressing Fire, all enemies in the line of your automatic fire are considered flat-footed against the next ranged attack to target them (other than your own) until the start of your next turn.
